question:
**Case Study 2: Economics – Input-Output Model**

A small economy has two industries: Agriculture (A) and Manufacturing (M). The input-output matrix (each entry represents units required per unit output) is $C = \begin{bmatrix} 0.2 & 0.3 \\ 0.1 & 0.4 \end{bmatrix}$. The demand vector for the next period is $D = \begin{bmatrix} 200 \\ 150 \end{bmatrix}$.

(a) Write the system of equations for total production vector $X = \begin{bmatrix} x_1 \\ x_2 \end{bmatrix}$, where $x_1$ and $x_2$ are outputs of A and M, respectively.
(b) Find the production vector $X$ to meet demand, using matrix inverse.
(c) Verify your answer by substituting the values back into the original equations.
explanation:
(a)

The total production $X$ must satisfy $X = C X + D$.

Thus, $X - C X = D$

$\implies (I - C) X = D$

Where $I$ is the 2x2 identity matrix.

(b)

Calculate $I - C$:

$I - C = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix} - \begin{bmatrix} 0.2 & 0.3 \\ 0.1 & 0.4 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0.8 & -0.3 \\ -0.1 & 0.6 \end{bmatrix}$

Now, $X = (I - C)^{-1} D$

First, compute the determinant:

$\det(I - C) = (0.8)(0.6)-( -0.3)( -0.1) = 0.48 - 0.03 = 0.45$

The inverse is:

$(I - C)^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{0.45} \begin{bmatrix} 0.6 & 0.3 \\ 0.1 & 0.8 \end{bmatrix}$

Now compute $X = (I - C)^{-1} D$:

$= \dfrac{1}{0.45} \begin{bmatrix} 0.6 & 0.3 \\ 0.1 & 0.8 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 200 \\ 150 \end{bmatrix}$

First row: $0.6\times200 + 0.3\times150 = 120 + 45 = 165$

Second row: $0.1\times200 + 0.8\times150 = 20 + 120 = 140$

So $X = \dfrac{1}{0.45} \begin{bmatrix} 165 \\ 140 \end{bmatrix}$

$X = \begin{bmatrix} \dfrac{165}{0.45} \\ \dfrac{140}{0.45} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 366.67 \\ 311.11 \end{bmatrix}$

(c)

Verify:

Now check $C X + D$:

$C X = \begin{bmatrix} 0.2 & 0.3 \\ 0.1 & 0.4 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 366.67 \\ 311.11 \end{bmatrix}$

Row 1: $0.2\times366.67 + 0.3\times311.11 = 73.33 + 93.33 = 166.66$

Row 2: $0.1\times366.67 + 0.4\times311.11 = 36.67 + 124.44 = 161.11$

$C X + D = \begin{bmatrix} 166.66 + 200 \\ 161.11 + 150 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 366.66 \\ 311.11 \end{bmatrix}$, matching $X$ (to rounding error), so the solution is verified.

options.C:
(a) $X=CD$.
(b) $X=\begin{bmatrix}85\\80\end{bmatrix}$.
(c) The production vector is smaller than demand.
options.D:
(a) $X=CX+D$, so $(I-C)X=D$.
(b) $I-C=\begin{bmatrix}0.8&-0.3\\-0.1&0.6\end{bmatrix}$ and $X=(I-C)^{-1}D=\begin{bmatrix}366.67\\311.11\end{bmatrix}$ approximately.
(c) Substitution in $CX+D$ gives $X$ up to rounding error.
